Game Overview

Mizu Quest 2 is a adventure title where dive into Mizu Quest 2, a vibrant 2D platformer where you guide a magical anime girl through eight thrilling levels. Navigate treacherous terrain, collect potions, and heal broken-hearted souls as you evade menacing monsters. With strategic jumps and clever timing, overcome obstacles in this colorful adventure filled with compassion and action.
